evidence: Lessons: (1) look at the chart, not only its tests: the screenshot showed a tooltip over the title and oversized axis text that no assertion caught; (2) config generation beats config docs: the e2e starts the server from the printed config, so 'no path edited' is tested; (3) toolsets must be read when modules are defined, so each value needs its own process in tests; (4) another work stream changed cli/src/harness meanwhile — classify reopened features by cause before re-verifying.
